title: alisma gramineum subsp. arcuatum
intro: Alisma gramineum subsp. arcuatum, commonly known as the Chinese water plantain, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Alismataceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and diuretic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of kidney stones, urinary tract infections, and edema. The bioactive constituents of Alisma gramineum subsp. arcuatum include iridoid glycosides, such as alisma dioscorin, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting urination and relieving pain. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to reduce fever, inhibit bacterial growth, and act as an antioxidant.
